photos.file: Teeth comparinson of Mimodactylus and Haopterus.jpg
photos.desc: Teeth comparinson of Mimodactylus libanensis (a) with Haopterus gracilis (b). Scale-bar: 1 mm. Arrows point to the cingulum at the base of the teeth.

The skull of Haopterus gracilis , which is collected from Chaoyang, Liaoning, China. This specimen (BMNHC Ph767) is a collection of Beijing Museum of Natural History and was on display in the National
Holotype of Haopterus gracilis on display at the Paleozoological Museum of China.
